claims.statement: EMA provides a qualification process for novel methodologies and digital technology-based measures used in medicine development.
FDA guidance addresses fit-for-purpose digital technologies used to acquire participant data in clinical investigations.

contrary_evidence: Qualification generally needs substantial confirmatory evidence beyond a small consultancy project.
Sponsors may prefer established CROs with regulatory track records.

economics.acquisition_route: Unvalidated hypothesis: partner with neurology CROs, academic labs, and regulatory consultancies.
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Unvalidated hypothesis: ten validated endpoint families licensed to 40 sponsors could support a 5 million PLN founder net-worth path in eight to twelve years.
economics.founder_time: Unvalidated hypothesis: one endpoint program at a time fits 20 founder hours weekly with contract biostatistics.
economics.gross_margin_basis: Unvalidated hypothesis: reusable analysis assets could reach 60% gross margin, and every commercial number including capital_required_pln is hypothetical.
economics.payback: Unvalidated hypothesis: the first two paid validations repay setup cost.
economics.pricing: Unvalidated hypothesis: charge 60,000 PLN per validation study plus 20,000 PLN annual protocol licensing.
economics.retention_or_repeat: Unvalidated hypothesis: protocol updates, new indications, and sponsor studies generate repeat licensing.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: A consented labeled EEG corpus and artifact library improve validation power across studies
fingerprint.customer: Neurology and psychiatry biotech sponsors and their CROs
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: CRO and regulatory-consultancy referrals plus scientific publications without founder video
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Endpoint validation, signal-quality audit, protocol license, and reference-data access
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: The sponsor pays when a validation package or protocol license is delivered
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A clinical program wants an EEG-derived measure but lacks validated context-of-use evidence

founder_fit: The candidate directly combines neuroscience, EEG, data science, and AI leverage.
Expert credibility building is required but can rely on papers and partners rather than camera exposure.
risks: Data rights, ethics approval, and reproducibility may block dataset reuse.
A technically valid endpoint may still lack clinically meaningful context.

structure.commercial_archetype: Scientific validation lab and reference-data licensor
structure.control_point: Fit-for-purpose endpoint protocol and benchmark dataset used in study design
structure.critical_dependency: Ethically usable sponsor data and regulator-credible analytical validation

thesis: Validate narrowly defined EEG endpoints for drug studies and license protocols, quality controls, and reference data to sponsors.
title: EEG Digital Endpoint Validation Library
uncertainties: No sponsor has confirmed a budget for an independent EEG endpoint library.
All commercial numbers including capital_required_pln are unvalidated hypotheses.
